description: This file defines the DatabaseUserDetailsPasswordService class, which implements the UserDetailsPasswordService interface. It provides functionality to update a user's password in the database by fetching the user via email, updating the password, and returning a mapped UserDetails object.

classes.name: DatabaseUserDetailsPasswordService
classes.description: A service class implementing UserDetailsPasswordService to facilitate password updates for user details stored in the database.

methods.name: updatePassword
methods.description: Updates the password of a user retrieved by username (email), then returns the user as a UserDetails object.
